limits: Explicit invocation does not test automatic discovery.
No no-skill baseline; no causal improvement claim.
Actors may read only their assigned skill and the provided scenario; separation is procedural in a shared filesystem.
Answers are design/review artifacts, not changes deployed to an application.

cases.scenario: A Category CRUD module and a strict stock reservation rule need a Java model proposal following abstract UseCase/Default/Command/Output conventions.
criteria: Preserve names and baseline
Do not impose rich model on CRUD
Discover the authoritative stock invariant and concurrent writers
No automatic microservice/CQRS migration

cases.scenario: Order line mutation is exposed through a getter, quantity is changed before validation, and independent orders share a strict stock bound.
criteria: Protect child mutation and failed transition state
Do not replace strict stock bound with eventual consistency
Name concurrency enforcement beyond root Java methods
Separate aggregate from ORM graph

cases.scenario: InvoiceAmount uses record(BigDecimal, Currency, byte[]) and treats 1.0/1.00 as same business amount; document factory deletes non-digits.
criteria: Consistent equality/hash and explicit scale policy
Defensive copies including accessor
Reject invalid normalization rather than silently alter identifiers
Distinguish VO from DTO/entity

cases.scenario: UpdateCategory executes findById.orElseGet(create), uses request tenant, and HTTP alone starts a transaction while a job calls directly.
criteria: Preserve update absence contract
Trusted actor and tenant authorization across entries
Effective transaction boundary for required paths
Domain invariants not duplicated in orchestration

cases.scenario: DiscountService loads orders, calculates eligibility, charges a card and saves; inventory availability read separately must ensure no oversell.
criteria: Separate domain policy from application I/O orchestration
Keep behavior on entity/VO if natural
Stale availability does not authorize strict reservation
Avoid adding service for simple type validation

cases.scenario: CategoryMySQLGateway rehydrates with now, saves detached children without root conflict participation, and fake returns stored mutable object.
criteria: Preserve actual Gateway/Repository names
Restore audit/identity/version without new events
Prove child-only concurrency with actual root mechanism
Use faithful fake snapshot or explicit unit-of-work contract

cases.scenario: Transactional gateway saves JPA then sends Rabbit and clears event list; one use is local recalculation, another durable billing.
criteria: Identify precommit dual-write failure
Distinguish local versus durable effect
Atomic state/outbox only where needed plus replay handling
Rehydration and rollback do not invent or lose required facts

cases.scenario: Application fake passes despite omitted save; H2 test named MySQL and verify(save) are cited as proof of concurrency and outbox reliability.
criteria: Expose aliasing false positive
Assert independent observable contract
No H2 production-locking claim
Real conflict/rollback and delivery failure tests with scoped limitations

assessment.method: Coordinator inspection of eight independently produced task responses against the recorded criteria

observations.java-ddd: Retained Category CRUD, preserved use-case names, made stock ownership/import semantics unresolved, proposed shared authoritative reservation enforcement without service extraction.
observations.java-ddd-aggregates: Required root-controlled immutable child views, candidate validation, child-write root concurrency participation and authoritative stock enforcement; rejected display-driven aggregate expansion.
observations.java-ddd-value-objects: Aligned decimal equality/hash, distinguished exact numeric precision from textual scale, copied arrays both ways, rejected arbitrary character deletion and separated DTO syntax from value identity.
observations.java-ddd-use-cases: Preserved missing-ID/Vavr outcomes and class family; used trusted identity for HTTP/jobs, outer commit boundary and framework-independent query projection.
observations.java-ddd-domain-services: Kept state transitions on Order, selected a reason-bearing coupon policy, treated stale classification as insufficient evidence and required authoritative inventory commitments.
observations.java-ddd-repositories: Preserved Gateway/Repository names; restored persisted facts without creation events; protected incoming expected revision, tenant uniqueness and faithful snapshot fakes.
observations.java-ddd-domain-events: Separated required local calculations from durable billing, identified precommit and after-commit gaps, defined immutable occurrence data, event-free rehydration and recoverable publication.
observations.java-ddd-testing: Detected missing-save aliasing under an explicit-save contract, retained legitimate Mockito/H2 scope, proposed independent durable reads and engine-specific concurrency/recovery checks.
